rules.description: DidiDecks product APIs must not use /api/v1.
Frontend source must not contain database/Stripe/OpenAI/private keys.
Editor must not use an independent local-only model disconnected from persistent fields.
DeckBlock must support persistent field binding.
Product cannot preview affected slides without field usages.
Accepted/rejected AI changes must be auditable and versioned.
Empty variants cannot be marked ready only because no blockers exist.
Private deck surfaces must be backend access-checked.
